title: It’s ok, not great
text: It’s ok, not great. It’s an ok desk. It is a little annoying to put together because of the angles of the desk. I used other sturdier screws than what came in package, I also had to make a different more sturdy keyboard holder the track doesn’t 100 percent line up on the one that I recieved as it was slightly bent.
